intro: The Queen of the Hills above Dehradun. That is Mussoorie in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Mussoorie
paragraphs: Mussoorie (Uttarakhand) is known for its hills, family and heritage experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is March to June and September to November.

sections.heading: Top things to do
list: Mall Road and Camel's Back Road

sections.heading: How to get there

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Walk up to Landour for the hill station Mussoorie used to be.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Mussoorie?

faq.q: Where should I stay in Mussoorie?
